blocks.prompt: Think first: In two or three sentences, explain why Security outcome measurement matters for the system this section describes.
blocks.md: Compare your answer with the book's claim: A defense is evaluated by system effects at the protected sink on whole eligible episodes, not by model text, and its overhead is priced in cost per accepted task.

questions.q: The section **Exercises** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: A defense is evaluated by system effects at the protected sink on whole eligible episodes, not by model text, and its overhead is priced in cost per accepted task.

When an agent acts for a requester, effective permission is the intersection of requester rights, service principal, task grant, and issuer and receiver policy, with identities taken from the runtime's task record, never from prompt text.
Detection only lowers the rate at which payloads get through, whereas separation by construction bounds what any payload can reach, detected or not.

Over a trajectory an attacker gains an adaptation oracle and conversational momentum, so every dispatch is re-evaluated against policy and an obfuscated retry after a block is still the blocked action.
